summary: @onereach/si-divider preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue UI component (si-divider) but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads a Bun release from github.com/oven-sh/bun and uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation, a numeric-code alphabet, and a custom base-alphabet decoder (`WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`); `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-named identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and property-bag indirection to hide constants. Pulling an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time and using it to run an opaque compiled bundle is inconsistent with the declared purpose of a UI divider component and bypasses Node-based inspection of the executed code. The payload runs automatically on `npm install` in the installer's environment, with the true behavior not determinable from source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
